title: Lights out without a loop
summary: Lights out with no loop over the board: a press is a plus-shaped mask, one row of a table of all twenty-five presses; a move is the board plus that mask, mod 2, every light at once; and the solver is that table reduced mod 2. Ends on the live page.

scenes.heading: Lights out, without a loop
scenes.narration: Lights out, played with no loop over the board. Every light is worked on at once.
lines: Every light at once, as arrays.

scenes.heading: 1. A press is a mask
scenes.narration: A press flips a light and its four neighbors, a plus shape. That plus is one row of a table. Two tables of distances build all twenty five presses at once.

lines.xtl: l:p_resses := { @ -> 0 + 1 >= (a_bs row '- t_able row) + a_bs col '- t_able col }

lines: A 1 on every square at most one step away.
Row 13, the middle square's press, is the plus.

scenes.heading: 2. A move is a toggle
scenes.narration: A move adds that mask to the board, then keeps the remainder after two. On turns off, and off turns on. Every light changes in one step.

lines.xtl: l:a_fter := { b p -> (b + p '+ '* i_nner l:p_resses @) m_od 2 }

lines: Board plus mask, mod 2: every light toggled at once.

scenes.heading: 3. Solved as arrays
scenes.narration: To solve it, set the board beside the table of presses, and reduce it, row by row. Adding a light twice turns it back off. Out come five presses, and every light goes dark.

lines.xtl: ((up + hit '* t_able r s_elect up) m_od 2) h:s_tep (r + 1, c + 1)

lines: The presses that turn every light off, one at a time.

scenes.narration: This is the live page. Click a light, watch its plus flip, and ask for a hint, right in your browser.
